title: Day and night animals
examples: Which animals are active when the sun is up?
Do all animals sleep during the day?
What is the difference between day and night animals?

explain.say: Some animals are awake in the day.

draw.text: Daytime activity: Awake in the day

explain.say: They are called diurnal animals. Robins and butterflies are busy in the day.

draw.text: Daytime activity: Awake in the day

explain.say: Other animals are awake at night.
They are called nocturnal animals. Owls, bats and badgers are nocturnal.
A squirrel is busy in the day and sleeps at night.
Some animals are busy at any time. Many fish swim about by day and by night.

faq.q: Do all animals sleep when the sun is shining?
faq.a: No. Some animals are awake in the day. They are called diurnal animals.
asks: Are there animals awake during the day?
Do all animals sleep by day?

faq.q: What do we call animals that are awake at night?
faq.a: They are called nocturnal animals. They are most active when it is dark.
asks: Which animals are active at night?

faq.q: Is it possible for an animal to be active both day and night?
faq.a: Yes. Some animals are active at different times, by day and by night.
asks: Can animals be awake both day and night?

faq.q: Why do some animals sleep during the day?
faq.a: Some sleep in the day to stay safe. They come out at night to find food.
asks: Do animals sleep to save energy?

faq.q: Does the time of day change an animal's behavior?
faq.a: Yes. The time of day changes when animals look for food and when they rest.
asks: Do animals change what they do by time?

facts: Diurnal animals are active during the day time.
Nocturnal animals are active during the night time.
Some animals are active both day and night.
Animals change their activity based on light levels.

quiz.say: When is a robin busy finding food?
quiz.why: Robins are diurnal. They are busy in the day.

wrong.1: Owls and bats are the ones busy at night.
wrong.2: Robins find food in all kinds of weather.

quiz.say: Owls hunt when it is dark. What kind of animal is an owl?
quiz.why: Nocturnal animals are busy at night, like owls.

wrong.0: Diurnal animals are busy in the day.
wrong.2: An owl is a bird, and it is busy at night.

quiz.say: Which animal sleeps in the day and comes out at night?
quiz.why: Bats are nocturnal. They sleep in the day and fly at night.

wrong.0: A robin is busy in the day.
wrong.1: Butterflies fly in the day, when it is warm.
